zh: 修复重绘模型选择器与座位上的模型名缺少「1017」发布标签的问题：官方渠道的 deepseek-flash 行在名字后面带上这个标签，座位上的当前模型名旁边也带着它。
en: Fix the redrawn model picker and the seat's model name missing the "1017" release tag on the official Flash model: the deepseek-flash row carries it after the name, and so does the seat's current model name.
